deviations.from: the Deliverable spec's option to leave the `## Getting started` prose unchanged once install-macos.md is removed
deviations.why: With three clauses against three links the mapping is one to one, but the third clause, "how an existing install becomes a newer one", is the first half of wiki/updates.md's own abstract with its second half dropped. wiki/updates.md:15-17 states nothing in it is built yet, so the clause promised a reader a route that the page it maps to cannot give. deviations.from: the smallest possible edit to the `## Meeting your persona` prose, which would have been to append a clause

The second sentence was recast instead: it now gives one clause each to the walkthrough, the record, and the three companion pages, and holds the arc in the first sentence to the three beats it already named, as ruled.
